description: This file defines the interface for SyncVk and related classes for Vulkan synchronization in the ANGLE project, including SyncHelper, SyncVk, and EGLSyncVk.

classes.name: SyncHelper
classes.description: Helper class implementing synchronization logic for Vulkan fences and events.

classes.name: SyncVk
classes.description: Final class implementing Vulkan fence synchronization, inherits from SyncImpl.

classes.name: EGLSyncVk
classes.description: Final class implementing EGL synchronization using Vulkan, inherits from EGLSyncImpl.
